product_one_liner.value: Horizon3's NodeZero is an AI-powered autonomous penetration-testing platform that helps enterprise security teams and service providers identify exploitable attack paths, prioritize remediation, and verify fixes.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing includes Flex, Core, Pro, and Elite plans, plus WebApp offerings.

named_customers.notes: Named organizations appear in the company's customer-story index.

employee_band.notes: The current LinkedIn company profile reports 501–1,000 employees, outside every permitted answer band. No permitted band can be asserted; the required schema value is a placeholder, not an employee-count finding.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by Naveen Sunkavally, identified on the team page as Distinguished Engineer: Advanced Data Pilfering (2025-11-04), explaining the ML/embedding/regex/LLM pipeline and isolation; and NodeZero vs. GOAD: Technical Deep Dive (2025-08-20), detailing autonomous attack execution and post-exploitation modules. These are technical articles within the main blog rather than a separately branded engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation contains quickstart, portal guides, API and CLI references, integrations, knowledge base, and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Autonomous Defense, US remote. The indexed official posting invites applications; the readable listing links to its official Ashby application and identifies the role as active.

model_provider.notes: Horizon3 explicitly says NodeZero runs inference against selected models hosted through AWS Bedrock. Specific underlying foundation-model names are not disclosed on these pages; its separate Anthropic research partnership is not treated as proof of a NodeZero production model.

compliance_certs.notes: Search-indexed trust-center content lists FY26 SOC 2 Type II and a SOC 2 Type II bridge letter. The trust-center pages did not render readable content through the scraper; evidence is from their indexed resource listings.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 3, 2026, at a valuation exceeding $2 billion; co-led by NightDragon and NEA.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 3, 2026 Series E falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Account Executive, MSP, posted November 5, 2026, with an official Ashby application link.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 29, 2026, Horizon3 launched AI-powered NodeZero WebApp penetration testing, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Horizon3 announced Chad Keefer's appointment as Vice President of Federal Sales on August 25, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Staff Account-Based Marketing Manager posting names these tools for CRM attribution, contact-level advertising, intent targeting, gifting, and paid media. 6sense and Bombora are excluded because they appear as examples of acceptable prior experience rather than clear usage evidence.
